Title: Home page load budget
Steps:
1. Navigate to home
2. Collect Navigation Timing + time to product grid
Expected Result: load < 5s; grid visible < 6s (configurable). Metrics attached to the report.

Title: /login latency
Preconditions: A registered user exists (auto-provisioned via API by the framework)

Title: Catalogue API sustains the target throughput (requests per second)
Steps:
1. Ramp the arrival rate to TARGET_RPS in 20 s
2. Hold TARGET_RPS for 1 min (mix of /entries and /view)
3. Ramp down in 10 s
Expected Result: At most 1% of planned requests dropped (system keeps up with the rate); error rate < 1%; p95 < 2 s.
Actual Result / Notes: 13 Oct 2026, TARGET_RPS=10: 750/750 requests sent, 0 dropped, 0 errors, p95 1.07 s. PASS

Title: Checkout flow smoke: 1 VU for 30 s
Preconditions: k6 installed; 1 user signed up in setup()
Steps:
1. npm run perf:smoke
2. Flow per iteration: login → add to cart → verify cart → place order → verify cart emptied
Expected Result: All thresholds pass: http_req_failed <1%, p95 <2 s, p99 <4 s, per-step p95 <1.5 s, checks >99%, business_errors <1%, checkout p95 <6 s.
Actual Result / Notes: Run 13 Oct 2026: 11 iterations, 100% checks, p95 547 ms — all thresholds passed.

Title: Checkout flow load: ramp to 5 VUs, hold 1 min
Preconditions: k6 installed; PEAK_VUS users signed up in setup()
Steps:
1. npm run perf:load
2. Same flow as TC-K6-001
Expected Result: Same thresholds as TC-K6-001 under sustained load.
Actual Result / Notes: Run nightly / on demand in the CI 'load' job.

Title: Checkout flow spike: 1 → 20 VUs in 10 s, hold 30 s, recover
Preconditions: k6 installed; 20 users signed up in setup()
Steps:
1. npm run perf:spike
2. Watch latency and errors during the ramp and after recovery
Expected Result: Same thresholds as TC-K6-001 during and after the spike; latency returns to baseline after ramp-down.
Actual Result / Notes: Run 13 Oct 2026: 301 orders, checks 99.90%, p95 557 ms, p99 999 ms, http_req_failed 0.06% (1/1525) — all thresholds passed.

Title: Throughput smoke: 2 requests per second for 30 s
Expected Result: All planned requests sent (≤ 1% dropped); error rate < 1%; p95 < 2 s.
Actual Result / Notes: 13 Oct 2026: 60/60 requests, 0 dropped, 0 errors, p95 0.96 s. PASS

Title: Throughput stress: step from TARGET_RPS to 2× TARGET_RPS
Preconditions: k6 installed; run against an environment you own for high rates
Steps:
1. Hold TARGET_RPS for 30 s
2. Step to STRESS_RPS and hold 30 s
3. Compare dropped requests, errors and p95 between the two steps
Expected Result: Shows where the system stops keeping up: dropped requests, errors or p95 rise. Fails the run if the limits of TC-PERF-004 are exceeded.
